io.github.mooy1.infinityexpansion.utils

Class CompatUtils

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.mooy1.infinityexpansion.utils.CompatUtils

  • public final class CompatUtils
extends java.lang.Object
    Java-8 universal port: reflective guards around Bukkit API members that only exist on MC 1.13+/1.14+ (the persistent-data container and Block#getBlockData()). On servers without them (1.8–1.12) these helpers degrade gracefully instead of throwing NoSuchMethodError/NoClassDefFoundError, while behaving identically on modern versions.

    All persistent-data access is routed through reflection on the real org.bukkit.NamespacedKey (obtained from the bundled NamespacedKey shim via BukkitKeys.toBukkit(NamespacedKey)), so neither PersistentDataType nor PersistentDataContainer is referenced in this addon's bytecode.

      • getDirectionalFacing

        @Nullable
public static org.bukkit.block.BlockFace getDirectionalFacing(@Nonnull
                                                                        org.bukkit.block.Block block)
        Returns the facing of a directional block (e.g. a wall sign) via Directional#getFacing(), resolved reflectively off the block's BlockData. Returns null on versions without BlockData or for non-directional blocks.
